judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition-of-done document (`.lore/dod.md`) and a single failing acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`). None of the production code was implemented: `src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, `config.ts`, `sessionStore.ts`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and the specification files are all completely untouched. Even within the acceptance test, the `history` option is cast with `as Partial<HalServerOptions>` because the option type was never added, and the tests themselves fail against the untouched codebase.
